line: Bog-rusted scrap, barely worth the charcoal to melt it down.

Good enough for patching a wheelbarrow, little else.
Stripped to raw tallow, hemp cord, and pitted iron.

Better in the scrap bin than weighing down your pack.
Sound border-grade metal—clean the salt off and it holds an edge.

Enough copper wire and cured leather to pay its weight.
